grouping: one publisher match_id in exactly one split; preserve every row for that match in capture order; no frame/point/random row split
eligibility: public live-observed score-state provenance only; original UTC capture order retained
completed BO3 singles metadata with distinct player IDs and empty retirement/walkover event_status; doubles and undocumented formats rejected
first recorded row must already provide valid nonterminal score and server; midmatch starts permitted and historical serve counts reset to the neutral prior without invented past points
each nonterminal observed row must provide a server and valid score; unknown server or ambiguous/skipped/reversed point transitions rejects the entire match
every point transition must uniquely match exactly one TennisScoringRules.award_point hypothetical winner under standard advantage games and seven-point set tiebreaks
undocumented deciding-set tie-breaks rejected instead of assuming a target
unchanged duplicate score/server states may be removed causally; asynchronous server corrections at an unchanged score reject the match
original capture UTC timestamps must be finite and nondecreasing, and all captures must remain inside the reserved whole-match chronological split
ledger must end in a normal rules-complete terminal score; terminal server and point-display cleanup may be ignored only after sets and completed game arrays exactly identify a unique terminal winner
no prediction quality or outcome-side criterion is used for eligibility, selection or parameter adjustment
bounded_selection: among all structurally eligible matches in each split, select the earliest scheduled UTC timestamp then lexicographic publisher match_id up to the fixed cap; publish all counts and exclusion reasons
features: current and past observed score/server plus past confirmed point winners within this same match only; no final result, future points, whole-match aggregates, next server, ratings or cross-match fitting
statistical_forecast: existing src/prediction/tennis.py rule recursion with neutral Beta(2,2) serve prior and causal past-point updates; no parameter tuning on this dataset
baseline: same causal current score/server and fixed neutral Beta(2,2) serve prior with no within-match performance updates
evaluation_snapshots: first observed nonterminal score and every valid nonterminal post-point state; final labels come from the validated observed terminal score, never enter forecast features; historical unobserved points are not reconstructed
metric_weighting: each evaluated match contributes equal total weight; snapshots divide that match weight
metrics: paired delta against neutral score-only baseline
calibration: chronological calibration split is measured separately but no calibrator fitted in v1; prediction remains uncalibrated
release_gate: No human review or separately confirmed winner is asserted. V2 is real publisher-score engineering evaluation only, and cannot satisfy independent qualification, calibration or physical camera gates.
amendments: a schema incompatibility may cause an explicit versioned protocol amendment before metrics are computed; never change eligibility/splits after viewing performance
amendment_reason: Publisher release has no separate winner/result column and most tapes start midmatch. V1 remains zero-eligible. V2 measures conditional suffix forecasts against validated observed terminal score labels, without claiming independently reviewed match outcomes or full-match point coverage.
outcome_reference: single publisher observed terminal score; independent of forecast model but not a separate human-reviewed result reference
scope: private engineering evaluation of complete unambiguous observed suffixes of BO3 singles matches; prediction remains unqualified
